description: Object /tests (spec 19.15, 19.20): the batch test run of lw test as a task-streamed method; the protocol-10 test request stays as its v0 alias. Discovery (discover) lands in step 5m.

run.description: Build the profile, then run its registered tests (lw test [<profile>] [--junit <file>] [-- <args>]).

profile.description: The profile (absent: the active one), resolved as the in-process command resolves it.

interactive.description: The client can ask the user (a terminal); without it a missing profile is refused, never onboarded.

command.description: The command name the task's lines quote (lw build, ...).

extra.description: Arguments passed to the test runner (after --).

junit.description: Write JUnit XML to this path.

result.description: The test run's end and its structured results.

steps.description: The test steps run (0: the profile has no tests).

failed.description: The names of the steps that failed.
